title: Copper(I) bis(diimine) sensitized titania nanotube array photoelectrodes for photoelectrochemical water oxidation
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, 9,1534-1544
DOI: 10.1039/D4SE01768D, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Joseph D. Chiong, Zujhar Singh, Joseph F. Ricardo-Noordberg, Nhat Truong Nguyen, Marek B. Majewski
Compact and vertically aligned TiO2 nanotubes functionalized with a molecular Cu(I) acceptor–chromophore–donor yield a photoanode capable of carrying out photoelectrochemical water oxidation with an Ir(III) pre-catalyst at an 84% Faradaic efficiency.
